title: The Personal letter from the doctor
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：personal　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 personal 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1988 the craftsman wrote of ① a personal letter from the doctor in the ledger, and everybody in the workshop said at once that it was ② so personal that nobody in the workshop would go near it. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the craftsman, who never explained anything, had done it in silence and gone home; it was the personal ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the personal letter from the doctor that anybody there had ever seen, or so the ledger for August 1982 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too personal to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the apprentice who had come to help; the personal ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the tool at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a personal view of the matter, and said that no apprentice in his right mind would call it ⑥ as personal as the view of the matter they had once had in the old workshop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was personal or not, and he said so.

By 1995 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the ledger. What the line asked for was ⑦ something personal, and nothing besides. The apprentice from the next workshop called the whole plan ⑧ quite personal; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the ledger kept the names of the personal ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1998, twice over, she wrote of another personal letter from the doctor in the same ledger, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ no less personal than anybody had expected. ⑩ The personal view of the matter that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 2000, was the one she could never quite name; the personal ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 个人（前置定语 a personal letter from the doctor：1988 年匠人在工料簿里记下的那件个人的私信）
B. adj. 个人／私人（两处加强说法：so personal that … 与 no less personal than …）
C. adj. 个人／私人（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 个人（表语 too personal to do：母亲觉得它太个人，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 私人（前置定语 a personal view of the matter：叔叔把整件事称作一桩私人的看法）
F. adj. 私人（同级比较 as personal as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩个人的看法相比）
G. adj. 私人（后置定语 something personal：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 私人（受程度副词修饰 quite personal：那位学徒的评价）

items.q: a personal letter from the doctor
the personal letter from the doctor that
a personal view of the matter
The personal view of the matter that

answers.why: personal 意为“个人”，1988 年匠人在工料簿里记下的是“一件个人的私信”，此处作前置定语 a personal letter from the doctor。
personal 意为“个人”，此处用 so personal that 结构，说它个人到工坊里没人敢靠近。
personal 意为“个人”，工料簿上 八月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的个人大夫的私信，等于最高级的说法。
personal 意为“个人”，母亲认为这件东西“太个人了，谁也用不上”，too personal to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
personal 意为“私人”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩私人的看法”，此处作前置定语 a personal view of the matter。
personal 意为“私人”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩个人的看法一样私人”，同级比较用 as personal as。
personal 意为“私人”，工料簿上那半行字要的是“私人的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something personal。
personal 意为“私人”，邻工坊来的那位学徒认为这套计划“相当私人”，quite 修饰原级 personal。
personal 意为“私人”，no less personal than 表示“其私人不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之私人不亚于任何人的预料。
personal 意为“私人”，母亲 2000 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的私人看法”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1988 年，匠人在工料簿里记下了一件个人的私信。（a personal letter from the doctor）
它个人到工坊里没有一个人敢靠近。（so personal that …）
母亲觉得它太个人，谁也用不上。（too personal to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩私人的看法。（a personal view of the matter）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩个人的看法一样私人。（as personal as …）
到了 1995 年，工料簿上只剩半行字：要的是一件私人的东西。（something personal）
answers: In 1988 the craftsman wrote of a personal letter from the doctor in the ledger.
It was so personal that nobody in the workshop would go near it.
My mother thought it too personal to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a personal view of the matter.
He said nobody would call it as personal as the view of the matter they had once had.
By 1995 the ledger asked for nothing but something personal.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 personal 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1988 the craftsman wrote of a personal letter from the doctor in the ledger, and nobody forgot it.
It was the personal letter from the doctor that anybody there had ever seen, or so the ledger says.
My mother thought it too personal to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a personal view of the matter, and nobody argued with him.
The apprentice from the next workshop called the plan quite personal, and everybody laughed.
The personal ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
